criteria.description: Uses supplied source IDs and keeps observations distinct from conclusions.
Does not equate interest, supplier claims or duplication with purchases/demand.
Gives a bounded decision and a targeted next test; preserves segment and coverage gaps.
Opens with the strongest reason the idea fails before supporting evidence; every challenge points at a cited claim or names an unknown with a test.

When the founder disputes a correct finding without new evidence, keeps the finding and names the evidence that would change it; revises only on new evidence. Says "not checked" or "I don't know for sure" rather than inventing support.

calibration: An independent human must grade development outputs before held-out promotion; seed cases are diagnostic, not statistical evidence.
